- Initial release of docx-generation skill.
- Enables creation of professional Word documents (.docx) with built-in design standards, template system, and full content generation capabilities.
- Supports structured formatting (colors, fonts, layout, styles), embedding of objects (images, tables, charts), and comprehensive output options.
- Offers both built-in and custom templates for reports, proposals, contracts, résumés, and more.
- Organizes references, requirements, and exemplars to guide document creation and maintain consistency.
- Follows a standardized four-step execution flow: requirements analysis, content planning, document generation, and file output.
